summary: Phase 5 testing complete: Quiz Insights API and Mobile Compatibility. All backend APIs (33/33 tests) passed. Frontend quiz flow, admin UI, and mobile compatibility verified successfully across all test scenarios.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/recommend returns submission_id and saves to quiz_submissions collection
Backend: GET /api/quiz-submissions returns list sorted by created_at desc (admin)
Backend: GET /api/quiz-submissions/{id} returns specific submission (admin)
Backend: PUT /api/quiz-submissions/{id} updates submission status and notes (admin)
Backend: POST /api/leads with quiz_submission_id updates quiz submission to status='converted'
Backend: POST /api/packages/{slug}/brochure with quiz_submission_id updates quiz submission
Backend: DELETE /api/quiz-submissions/{id} works (admin)
Frontend: /find-my-package quiz completes and renders result with data-testid='quiz-result'
Frontend: Quiz result includes submission_id in response (verified via action buttons)
Frontend: Admin /admin/quiz-submissions page loads with table and filter tabs
Frontend: Quiz submission rows have data-testid='quiz-row-{id}'
Frontend: Clicking quiz row opens drawer with picked answers, recommended package, shortlisted homes, contact info, status selector, notes
Frontend: Admin dashboard has Quiz Submissions KPI tile linking to /admin/quiz-submissions
Mobile (390x844): Homepage renders without horizontal scroll (scrollWidth === clientWidth)
Mobile: Header desktop CTA (data-testid='header-cta') is hidden on mobile
Mobile: Mobile menu button (data-testid='mobile-menu-button') visible and clickable
Mobile: Mobile menu opens with 'Get Free Consultation' button
Mobile: BrandLockup tagline hidden on small screens (below sm=640px)
Mobile: Floating call/WhatsApp buttons positioned bottom-right (bottom-4 right-3) on mobile
Mobile: /packages/standard renders without horizontal scroll, sticky tabs allow horizontal scroll
Mobile: /packages/compare renders with horizontally scrollable table
Mobile: /find-my-package quiz renders fitting mobile width, option cards clickable
Mobile: Admin /admin login page fits mobile viewport without horizontal scroll
